title: Trade Accounting Note: Chargeback Basis Where Kestrel Paid a Lien
content:
What Kestrel paid out for the lien on a **Trade-In Agreements** trade sets the chargeback basis, the amount the title-delay chargeback percentage is applied to; it is read from the agreement's history.

## Rule

| Entries standing on the agreement | Chargeback basis |
|---|---|
| A lien payoff entry and at least one customer payment entry | The total of the lien payoff entries less the total of the customer payment entries |
| A lien payoff entry and no customer payment entry | The lesser of the total of the lien payoff entries and the value credited |
| No lien payoff entry | The value credited |

The value credited is the total of the agreement's value-credited entries. Customer payment entries are the covering entries the customer paid from their own funds; a covering entry rolled into financing is not one of them.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures; value credited $14000.00)

| Lien payoff entries | Customer payment entries | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| $16200.00 | $2200.00 | $14000.00 |
| $16200.00 | $3000.00 | $13200.00 |
| $11500.00 | None | $11500.00 (lesser of $11500.00 and $14000.00) |
| $15800.00 | None | $14000.00 (lesser of $15800.00 and $14000.00) |
| None | None | $14000.00 |
